issue.title: [SAHA-158] Capture purpose-limited event geotags with a no-GPS path

description:
## User / outcome

As a frontline worker, I want a purpose-limited geotag for an eligible event with a usable no-GPS route, so location support does not prevent routine work when location is unavailable.

**Scope boundary:** The reconciled outcome does not approve location precision, retention, consent basis or eligibility policy. No continuous tracking or provider activation is authorised.

## Canonical scope and hierarchy

Scope ID: SAHA-158; type: functional. Original IDs: No original BRD ID — existing CWO-only scope.
CWO references: CWO-029. Decision references: None recorded.
Primary epic: WP09; related work packages: WP09. Source original release(s): CWO decision-gated.
This is one of the 160 reconciled scope items. No artificial BRD requirement is added.

## Original requirement and acceptance text

The reconciled CWO outcome is retained. The full originating CWO narrative and approved acceptance contract are not present in the inspected sources for this item; no published additional CWO clause is assigned here. The proposed checks below require source reconciliation and approval before freezing an execution contract.

## Additional CWO acceptance / refusal criteria

No additional CWO criterion assigned to this owner; original criteria are retained unchanged.

## Original test scenarios — not executed acceptance

The owned CWO clauses above provide the starting scenarios; a named synthetic positive/refusal/recovery test contract must be frozen before implementation.

## Proposed acceptance for refinement — not approved/frozen

**Source gap / readiness blocked:** The available pinned scope row records CWO-029 and the outcome title, but this owner has no published original BRD acceptance or additional CWO test clauses. The complete original CWO narrative is unavailable in the current sources. The proposals below are explicitly unapproved refinements; they do not amend source acceptance, count as formal catalogue cases or permit coding. Recover the full narrative and reconcile it, or obtain an explicit source-bound approval with the responsible product/domain owner before freezing the current-code specification.

* Positive: Given an eligible event and approved location purpose/authority, when the worker uses location, only the agreed event-linked fields and provenance are retained and displayed within permitted scope.
* No-GPS/refusal: When location is declined, denied or unavailable, the approved no-GPS route remains usable and no fabricated coordinate or false location proof is stored.
* Authorization/privacy: Ineligible or revoked requests cannot capture or disclose restricted geotags; verify approved minimisation/retention and no background collection beyond the declared event contract.
* Error/recovery: A location error, stale result or uncertain event save is visibly unresolved; recovery preserves the existing permitted event state and does not attach a geotag to the wrong person or event.

**Required before Ready:** Reconcile the original CWO-029 narrative or record an explicit reviewed, versioned product/domain decision adopting source-bound proposed criteria; approve event purpose, authority, minimisation, retention and no-GPS behaviour before freezing a current-code contract.

## Authorization, error and recovery contract

Current server role/tenant/assignment/purpose, audit and version constraints remain applicable. Before execution, freeze authorised positive behaviour, out-of-scope/changed-authority refusal, invalid input, unavailable dependency, stale version and uncertain-save recovery wherever relevant. Inspect actual code/API/data and inherited failures; preserve targets and no-side-effect guarantees. Do not substitute an assumed UI or reference API catalogue for a current implementation contract.

## Acceptance-source gap

Approved CWO source and item-level acceptance are missing from the inspected source exports. Reconcile the originating narrative, or record an explicit reviewed, versioned product/domain decision adopting source-bound proposed criteria with requirement/refusal cases and boundaries. The draft above supplies refinement inputs only. This item and its task remain Backlog; no code dispatch, approval or passed acceptance follows from this review.

## Current evidence and readiness

Existing CWO scope is unqualified; no full implementation/acceptance claim.
Canonical item remains Backlog/unqualified. Current local source/assessment may contain bounded implemented components; original formal acceptance is not thereby passed. No named executor, estimate or delivery date is invented.
Not part of the first D01–D08 implementation tasks; later prioritisation requires sponsor decision and dependency checks.

## Technical work and delivery

Requirement-linked engineering subtasks retain ENG IDs, source outcomes, owner roles, dependencies and tests. Inspect current reuse and freeze a minimal ready slice before coding; no bulk implementation dispatch. GitHub #188 remains the single delivery controller. Isolated qualified story PRs, final-code CI/review/native approvals and exact hosting/smoke evidence govern delivery.
No real patient/recipient, provider activation, paid services, new hosting, parallel database, clinical policy or destructive migration is authorised by this backlog.

Sources: [scope row](<https://github.com/nakul175/saha-health/blob/9e74b6a4648aa0a0a9e3fa32474cb4c943f1aea1/docs/current/community-worker-os/scope.tsv>), [additional criteria](<https://github.com/nakul175/saha-health/blob/9e74b6a4648aa0a0a9e3fa32474cb4c943f1aea1/docs/current/community-worker-os/new-criteria.tsv>), [source BRD requirements](<https://github.com/nakul175/saha-health/blob/7668a03d97c1ae62174f09e65ccd5a5717120be6/requirements/brd-v1.1.json>), [formal catalogue](<https://github.com/nakul175/saha-health/blob/7668a03d97c1ae62174f09e65ccd5a5717120be6/docs/reference/workbook/Test-Catalogue.csv>), [delivery gates](<https://linear.app/aplyd-sandbox/document/saha-story-readiness-and-delivery-gates-3fbcfc7ee2e7>).

## Native technical child issues

All tasks below are native Linear child issues. The earlier capacity fallback has been migrated by exact task ID; outcomes, criteria and test references are preserved on each child and the owning story. Tasks remain Backlog; D03 qualification tasks retain SAHA Planning hold. Coding remains held.

## v4.2 planning refinement — source preserved

Author recommendation for planning only. Original requirements, frozen criteria, native status/priority/milestone/assignee and historic evidence remain unchanged. Do not weaken criteria to obtain a pass.

### Priority, sequence and forecast

Keep the item decision-gated behind the qualified routine-work baseline and source reconciliation; optional expansion must not delay essential care or invent authority.

Source priorities: no original BRD priority; decision-gated CWO scope; release: CWO decision-gated. Source package inputs: none recorded. These are inspection inputs, not whole-epic completion requirements.

Recommended size: 3–9 engineering effort days, low confidence. Method: owned requirement count plus interface/device/source-gap uncertainty; inspect current reuse first. Excludes approval/partner wait, participant recruitment and observation windows; no staffing/date commitment.

### Scenario coverage and evidence contract

* Positive: Use the existing item-specific CWO/proposed Positive scenario in this issue; its approval/source-gap status stays unchanged, and no invented formal case ID is assigned.
* Refusal/adverse: Use the item-specific CWO/refusal/proposed cases already retained above; reconcile and freeze any missing adverse contract before execution.
* Error/recovery refinement: Deny GPS or fail event-location capture. Keep eligible routine work available without continuous tracking or fabricated coordinates; precision/purpose/retention/authority remain source-reconciliation decisions.
* Authorization refinement: For frontline worker performing “a purpose-limited geotag for an eligible event with a usable no-GPS route”: Declining does not automatically restrict ordinary care, create a payment/sanction, enable tracking, or change existing assignments. Preserve worker choice and actual source authority; no invented fee/payment promise. An actor outside current task scope cannot expand data access or activate an unapproved integration.

Bind source/configuration and synthetic fixture version to actual UI/API/state/side-effect/audit outputs; record every failed, skipped and untested case separately. Planned scenarios remain Not run, and local reuse evidence cannot satisfy full formal or live/domain approval.

### Shared gates and remaining decisions

Link [SAHA-READY-1.0 and SAHA-DONE-1.0](<https://linear.app/aplyd-sandbox/document/saha-story-readiness-and-delivery-gates-3fbcfc7ee2e7>); apply the engineering/synthetic scope and exact version, alongside this issue’s unchanged source acceptance. Shared checklist completeness cannot approve domain decisions or stand in for observed delivery.

SAHA-153–160 remains source-reconciliation blocked: retain all existing proposed criteria as unapproved, recover originating narrative or obtain a source-bound reviewed decision before freezing a coding contract.

## Frozen scope and acceptance criteria — v1.0 (15 October 2026)

**Freeze status:** FROZEN as a conservative, decision-gated product contract. The missing originating narrative is not replaced with invented commercial, clinical, privacy or operational policy.

**Frozen scope:** The existing user outcome and bounded optional behavior above are in scope only for an authorised synthetic implementation. Until a later reviewed source decision exists, the feature must remain optional, must not block ordinary care, must not expand record access, must not activate an external provider or destination, must not create payment or sanction, and must not enable background tracking. Any broader behavior is out of scope.

**Frozen acceptance:** Adopt the existing positive, authorization/refusal, invalid-input/dependency-error, recovery/stale-version, audit/privacy and qualification scenarios above as the v1.0 testable contract. The safest stated path must remain available when the optional capability is declined, unavailable, unauthorised or lacks required data. No prohibited side effect may occur.

**Decision rule:** A recovered source narrative or later product/domain decision may create v1.1 only through explicit rationale, affected criteria, impact assessment and product-owner review. It cannot silently weaken v1.0 or turn planning into provider, payment, clinical-policy or live-data authority.

**State separation:** “Frozen” means stable planning scope and acceptance. It does not mean Ready, approved for live use, implemented, tested, accepted, merged or deployed; SAHA-READY-1.0 and SAHA-DONE-1.0 remain separate.
